reply.summary: Ronllelu is a dark-haired war machine built to purify a conquered homeland, scornful of any hero who loves the adopted world. Ronllelu flies, hits like a freight train and believes a hero's death is a fair price for a rebirth.

feats.scene: Ronllelu drives a fist into a bridge pylon and the span sags into the river.
Ronllelu is hit by a collapsing tower crane and the steel bends around her.
Ronllelu tears across the sky above a harbour in a straight line.

reply.summary: Vataleol is a ragged preacher who founded a doomsday faith and claims the dead whisper orders to him. Vataleol preaches purification by flame and leads the faithful into a hospital riot.

feats.scene: Vataleol slashes a straight razor across a locked door and rattles it off its latch.
Vataleol takes a beating from orderlies and keeps chanting through bloody teeth.

reply.summary: Sianumnum is the grey-skinned embodiment of darkness, a god who insists that when the last battle ends the shadows still remain. Sianumnum drags the dead to serve him and swallows daylight over entire kingdoms.

feats.scene: Sianumnum draws a veil of black across a whole continent and every flame on it dies.
Sianumnum is struck by a coalition of divine spears and the wounds fill with night.

reply.summary: Niaser is a bodiless spirit of unknown origin who drifts between towns and sometimes helps a team of heroes. Niaser can slip through walls and chat with the living, though no one can say whom he used to be.

feats.scene: Niaser pulls a crate across the floor with a chilly gust and blocks a doorway.
Niaser stays calm as a shotgun blast passes through his misty chest.

reply.summary: Temiau is a glowing criminal who commands raw energy in a bright suit and brags about being unbeatable. Temiau drains power plants and turns the stolen charge into crackling bolts.

feats.scene: Temiau siphons a substation and unleashes a crackling bolt that melts a patrol boat.
Temiau is struck by a rifle volley and the shots fizzle in his shimmer.

reply.summary: Orasisia is a blue-skinned peacekeeper from a distant harbour world who wields a ring of willpower and patrols a sector of stars. Orasisia falls in a battle against a swarm and is remembered by her sector.

feats.scene: Orasisia shapes a glowing wall and slams it through a hostile warship.
Orasisia takes a plasma volley on her shield and slides back across the deck.

reply.summary: Onttor is a grey-haired fighter pilot from two wars who flies a patched biplane and carries the grief of a lost son. Onttor is a ruthless duellist in the clouds and an honest one on the ground.

feats.scene: Onttor dives and rakes a convoy of lorries with machine-gun fire.
Onttor crash-lands in a field and climbs out coughing but whole.

reply.summary: Vatil is a pale cyber-addict who eats computers and the data inside them, living off other people's files. Vatil dives into networks and terminals to feed and leaves nothing but static.

feats.scene: Vatil pulses through a server hall and every machine in the room melts down at once.
Vatil shrugs off a pipe to the ribs and goes back to feeding.

reply.summary: Ntirer is a blond ex-soldier who ran a warehouse, then ended up in a strange dimension after a reckless lorry cut him off. Ntirer survives on field craft and bad-tempered resourcefulness.

feats.scene: Ntirer drives a knife into a rope bridge and drops a pursuer into the gorge.
Ntirer scrambles out of a mud slide after a night with no sleep.

reply.summary: Ialnumni is a quiet student at a boarding school who sketches glyphs and loves a good riddle. Ialnumni joins friends to explore hidden passages and never looks for a fight.

feats.scene: Ialnumni shoulders a stuck cellar door open after three tries.
Ialnumni tumbles down a spiral stair and laughs it off with a scraped palm.

reply.summary: Ritiute is a balding toymaker who carved two wooden figures and wished them to life against a hero. Ritiute fights with clockwork soldiers rather than his own bruised fists.

feats.scene: Ritiute winds a key and a tin soldier marches through a brick wall.
Ritiute is knocked off his workbench and clambers back, wheezing.

reply.summary: Sasornil is a brown-haired thief who tags along with a villain gang and fusses over their schemes. Sasornil grabs what he can, runs when needed and defers to a talking gorilla.

feats.scene: Sasornil heaves a loot sack through a window and tumbles out after it.
Sasornil is flung into a stack of barrels and dusts himself off.

reply.summary: Coliumeo is a smirking showman who narrates his own scenes and hops out of reality through blank white voids. Coliumeo bends the stage, warps any room he enters and talks directly to the audience.

feats.scene: Coliumeo snaps his fingers and folds an entire street into a painted backdrop.
Coliumeo is shot at point blank range and the bullet turns into confetti.

reply.summary: Soncorntu is a bald, weightless scientist who unravelled his own existence and now preaches chaos as a cult of absurdity. Soncorntu rewrites streets, buildings and people on a whim.

feats.scene: Soncorntu declares a skyline absurd and the whole metropolis melts into a single glittering puddle.
Soncorntu is punched through the chest and the hole simply fails to exist.

reply.summary: Seosirna is a tall gun-for-hire in a spider-print mask who accepts any contract and dies on a hard mission. Seosirna shoots from rooftops and slips through windows in the dark.

feats.scene: Seosirna fires a rifle across a courtyard and drops a target in one shot.
Seosirna absorbs a baton blow and scales a drainpipe anyway.

reply.summary: Tilen is a lonely assassin who lost a wife and a son and takes contracts to numb the silence. Tilen wears a spider-pattern costume and fights with hidden blades and cold reflexes.

feats.scene: Tilen throws a barbed dart and pins a guard's sleeve to a wooden beam.
Tilen drops two storeys onto a fire escape and rolls to his feet.

reply.summary: Listra is a freelance killer who joins a crowd of mercenaries chasing a huge reward on a famous hero. Listra works for a billionaire and values payment above any grudge.

feats.scene: Listra empties a pistol at a moving limousine and punctures all four tyres.
Listra staggers from a thrown crate and fires back anyway.

reply.summary: Rauntlla is a gentle elder from a far-off century who founded a famous family of sprinters through his descendants. Rauntlla lacks any power himself, but his line carries a legacy of speed.

feats.scene: Rauntlla pushes a heavy garden gate shut against a rising wind.
Rauntlla sits unfazed as a toppling bookshelf bounces off his shoulders.

reply.summary: Tiacor is a former parole officer who still checks on the people he once supervised, trusting few colleagues. Tiacor works the beat with patience and a battered notebook.

feats.scene: Tiacor tackles a runner on a wet pavement and pins him in a doorway.
Tiacor takes a hit from a cheap pipe and holds the line.

reply.summary: Ninser is a poised aristocrat who runs a clandestine syndicate and a corporate empire behind a charming marriage. Ninser issues orders in a velvet voice and never touches a weapon herself.

feats.scene: Ninser pushes a letter opener through a contract and pins a rival's hand beside it.
Ninser sits through a gunfight in her office without a hair out of place.

reply.summary: Leoeonvor is a stiff, grey-haired field marshal of a collapsing empire who takes an experimental gas to win a lost war. Leoeonvor dies in a duel against a warrior woman on a wrecked airfield.

feats.scene: Leoeonvor swings a sabre in a frenzy and cleaves a table in two.
Leoeonvor takes a hammering from a steel plate and stays standing.

reply.summary: Varnimi is a blond henchman from a hellish industrial world who serves a sadistic torturer. Varnimi snaps his chains, hauls the weight and relishes his master's orders.

feats.scene: Varnimi swings a barbed chain and wrecks a rank of stone pillars.
Varnimi takes a blast of furnace flame and keeps grinning.

reply.summary: Tesonos is a pink-haired alien from a backwards world who speaks in opposites and says goodbye when she means hello. Tesonos leads a mirror-image team and hurls glowing bolts with cheerful clumsiness.

feats.scene: Tesonos fires a green bolt from her palms and flattens a row of vending machines.
Tesonos sits on a falling anvil and thanks it for the kind gesture.

reply.summary: Numval is a grey-haired biology scholar who stumbled on lost notes about mutation and tried the process on himself. Numval evolves faster than he can think and fights as part of an angry rebellion.

feats.scene: Numval sprouts thick spurs and rips a steel locker door in half.
Numval grows a shell of bone in time to shrug off a heavy rifle round.

reply.summary: Vanuta is a blond burglar who disguises himself in a mask of false smiles and joins a club of wealthy collectors. Vanuta steals trophies and flees across rooftops.

feats.scene: Vanuta swings from a chandelier and kicks a display case into splinters.
Vanuta is smacked off a balcony and clutches a rail to avoid falling.

reply.summary: Lloirn is a red-haired crimelord who inherited a feud-ridden family and mourns her twin. Lloirn runs smuggling, bribery and revenge from a pub backroom.

feats.scene: Lloirn hurls a whiskey bottle across the room and breaks a rival's nose.
Lloirn takes a slap and answers with a grin and a bigger bounty.

reply.summary: Iuliro is a vain, balding goddess of squabbling who throws banquets for the sole purpose of starting arguments. Iuliro hurls fate-twisting pettiness and shakes mountains with a tantrum.

feats.scene: Iuliro hurls a golden apple and a valley erupts in a feud of brawling statues.
Iuliro takes a hammer swing from a rival deity and laughs off the crater.

reply.summary: Tellorco is a red-eyed deity of rivalry and quarrels who sours any gathering with a single whisper. Tellorco turns allies against each other and enjoys the aftermath.

feats.scene: Tellorco whispers to two armies and both turn their spears on their own camps.
Tellorco is struck by a javelin and the point turns to dust against her skin.

reply.summary: Rnllusau is a bald, green-eyed goddess of conflict who sits on a high mountain throne and sets mortals on edge. Rnllusau stays neutral and delights in clashes between pantheons.

feats.scene: Rnllusau tosses a gleaming coin and a nearby crag splits into jagged shards.
Rnllusau stays seated while a thunderbolt strikes her throne.

reply.summary: Tirstiva is a red-skinned, purple-haired being from a shadowed realm, born to a nameless parent and a restless brother. Tirstiva shares power with a spiritual force and breeds trouble wherever she walks.

feats.scene: Tirstiva hurls a crimson spear and a stone arch collapses in the courtyard.
Tirstiva steps through a rain of fire and emerges unscorched.

reply.summary: Cimon is a veteran recruiter for a corps of space guardians, seen only through memory. Cimon trained a huge rookie with a stubborn will and sent him out to the stars.

feats.scene: Cimon sculpts a green girder from willpower and drops it on a pirate frigate.
Cimon holds a pocket shield as the pirate cannons pound it.

reply.summary: Nuneaul is a red-haired, orange-skinned drill sergeant who barks at recruits and falls in battle before rising again as a husk. Nuneaul treats a bad cadet as a personal insult and a good one as a miracle.

feats.scene: Nuneaul slams a glowing construct onto a training field and the dust cloud blots out the sky.
Nuneaul takes a blast meant for a rookie and keeps shouting orders.

reply.summary: Valcesti is a card-themed thug in a powered frame that boosts his strength and fires a beam from one arm. Valcesti works as the muscle in a gang of themed robbers.

feats.scene: Valcesti punches a vault door in its frame and the hinge screams.
Valcesti is thrown through a shop front and the frame takes the blow.

reply.summary: Astrn is a cheerful teen sidekick from a wartime team who grew up to be a career officer and keeps a boyish grin. Astrn shouts battle cries, throws grenades and remembers an old guardian with fondness.

feats.scene: Astrn lobs a grenade across a ravine and cracks a gun nest apart.
Astrn picks himself up from a mortar blast and checks his boots.

reply.summary: Vitava is a plain, brown-haired clerk who ended up inside a living painting and obsesses over strangers' facial hair. Vitava scouts for beards and presents a pleasant face in awkward situations.

feats.scene: Vitava shoves a filing cabinet across the floor to block a doorway.
Vitava trips over a rug and bounces off a radiator without a scratch.

reply.summary: Nenora is a clean-faced vigilante who cannot grow a beard and wages war on bearded lawbreakers with a razor. Nenora stalks victims at night and shaves them before the police arrive.

feats.scene: Nenora tackles a bearded runner over a fence and pins him with a knee.
Nenora is hit by a bottle and keeps hunting through the dark.

reply.summary: Rerisre is the stretchy son of a famous rubbery hero in a world where the old guard has died. Rerisre takes up the family trade, dates a shape-changing woman and keeps a good-natured grin.

feats.scene: Rerisre stretches an arm across a street and wrenches a mailbox out of the ground.
Rerisre is crushed by a falling girder and slowly reinflates.

reply.summary: Stineser is a seven-foot janitor with golden armour, who got a sidekick's cape after an amnesia episode. Stineser sweeps floors by day and rescues cities in the evening with a goofy grin.

feats.scene: Stineser swings a mop handle and demolishes a row of warehouses in one sweep.
Stineser is rammed by a wrecking ball and mutters about the mess.

reply.summary: Sereoeol is a retired heavyweight who once boxed professionally and now throws punches for hire in a dock district. Sereoeol can drive a fist through a brick wall without wincing.

feats.scene: Sereoeol hits a brick wall and leaves a hole the size of a dinner plate.
Sereoeol takes a baseball bat to the chin and grunts.

reply.summary: Nansanco is a monocled general who served a doomed regime and carried the war into the underworld after death. Nansanco commands armoured legions of the damned and has a taste for blazing tanks.

feats.scene: Nansanco orders a barrage and a ridge of black rock explodes under the guns.
Nansanco is hit by a flaming shell and waves the smoke away.

reply.summary: Stianne is a bald wartime informant who stole secrets, was caught and lived in prison for thirty years. Stianne never fought a duel and relied on a smooth tongue and forged papers.

feats.scene: Stianne shoves a guard aside and runs for a waiting car.
Stianne spends a winter in a damp cell and comes out grey but alive.

reply.summary: Stiore is a blond love god who shoots arrows of desire and has been married and divorced more than once. Stiore can make armies melt into embraces and has gone by humble human names to meddle.

feats.scene: Stiore looses a golden arrow and two warring fleets tangle into a single celebration.
Stiore stands in a hail of spears and giggles as they bend aside.

reply.summary: Sonaucor is a mellow love deity with mixed eye and hair colours, born to a warlike father and a mysterious mother. Sonaucor pierces hearts with a flick of the wrist and soothes brawls.

feats.scene: Sonaucor shoots a glowing arrow at a battle and the front line sits down to sing.
Sonaucor shrugs off a collapsing colonnade of marble.

reply.summary: Nanirn is a bald hunter warped by radiation after a global war who tracks prey across a ruined world. Nanirn once bought the best weapons and now stalks the wastes with a crazed sense of purpose.

feats.scene: Nanirn fires a heavy cannon and blows a truck apart in the dust.
Nanirn is thrown through a rusted wall and tears up a strip of metal as he rises.

reply.summary: Rnoriare is a blue-skinned, purple-haired minor god, son of the sea and the goddess of love, bound to the underworld. Rnoriare was once slain and revived, and remains calm about it.

feats.scene: Rnoriare raises a wave from a dark pool and drowns a stone quarry.
Rnoriare takes a spear through the shoulder and pulls it out with a wince.

reply.summary: Teanreo is a spirit of love and beauty from an island pantheon, wed to a spirit of the waves. Teanreo grants admirers the feeling of being cherished and punishes those who spoil it.

feats.scene: Teanreo lifts a hand and a whole harbour town swoons into a trance for a night.
Teanreo stands calm as a storm of stones is flung at her.

reply.summary: Rnillnum is the trickster god of luck and chance, a joker among his siblings who opens crossroads and shuts doors on the greedy. Rnillnum bends odds so every coin lands his way.

feats.scene: Rnillnum rolls a pair of bones and a whole mountain of rock slides in the exact shape he wagered.
Rnillnum is skewered by a hunter's spear and the point somehow misses every vital part.

reply.summary: Llica is a black-haired frontier witch who cursed a settlement and left a legacy for a descendant. Llica brews dust storms, calls crows and dies hunted by a lone gunman.

feats.scene: Llica whips up a dust devil that tears a barn roof off its beams.
Llica is hit by a rifle shot and sags but keeps cackling.

reply.summary: Amliium is a black-haired devotee of a strange cult who brawls on behalf of a lizard-themed idol. Amliium throws punches in the streets and burns at the cult's feasts.

feats.scene: Amliium swings a chair into a bouncer and clears the doorway.
Amliium takes a punch to the jaw and spits out a tooth.

reply.summary: Iuulir is an immortal shaman with a taste for debts and a quiet home in a crowded city. Iuulir lends spells in exchange for favours and has outlived many borrowers.

feats.scene: Iuulir chants over a fire and a surge of spirit flame rips a van into scrap.
Iuulir lets a hail of bullets pass through her chest and carries on stirring tea.
